implementationPlan.note:
SIDECAR + FEED/RENDER/DISPATCH FENCES LANDED (DoD 2 + 3).

(a) NEW apps/control-room/src/live/live-planning-authorities.ts — 236 lines (cap 250). Bridge live-planning-authorities.js is exactly one LF line, `export * from "./live-planning-authorities.ts";`, byte-format-identical to the daemon sibling's bridge (od -c confirmed: single trailing \n, no CRLF, no BOM).

PARSING IS DESCRIPTOR-ONLY. `ownValue()` is the module's ONLY read: `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor` + `"value" in descriptor` + `enumerable`, wrapped in try/catch for revoked proxies, returning a private ABSENT symbol on a miss. There is no plain property access anywhere in the validation path, so "refuses without evaluation" is literally true and the three-depth zero-invocation arm passes.
Admitted: plain or null-prototype maps, <= 256 entries (inclusive), exact seven-key records checked as a SET (`keys.length !== ENTRY_KEYS.length` plus membership, so a swap of one key for another is refused), 512-BYTE ids via TextEncoder with a character pre-bound so a hostile megastring is never encoded, lowercase /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/u hashes, and CANONICAL base64 — length % 4, alphabet, and the discarded-bit tails (`[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]=` / `[AQgw]==`), because atob/Buffer decode whitespace, url-safe and short padding best-effort and the daemon's ingress then answers PLANNING_GRAPH_CONTENT_MALFORMED.
`snapshot()` deep-COPIES and `Object.freeze`s the authority under the SHARED bounds imported from @moe/contracts (MAX_JSON_DEPTH 64, MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES 1_048_576) plus <= 4096 nodes, using `undefined` as the refusal sentinel (never a legitimate JSON member). Refuses: accessors, symbol keys, functions/bigint/undefined, nonfinite numbers and NaN, non-Object/Array prototypes, and arrays whose own keys are not exactly the dense indices plus `length` — which catches BOTH a sparse hole and an injected own key with one check. A cycle terminates on the depth bound.
BINDINGS ARE CHECKED, NEVER REPAIRED: `runId !== mapKey` refuses, and `goalRef !== ownValue(goalRefs, runId)` refuses — the latter also refusing when the run is unbound, since ABSENT never equals a string. A surface stating material with NO planningGoalRefs refuses whole (there is nothing to check the binding against).

(b) SIDECAR: `const MATERIAL = new WeakMap<object, PlanningMaterial>()`, module-owned. `PlanningMaterial` is NOT exported — only `bindPlanningAuthorities`, `hasPlanningMaterial` and `PLANNING_AUTHORITY_KINDS` cross the boundary, so there is no broad type fan-out and caller-minted material is unrepresentable rather than merely discouraged. SurfaceFrame and DispatchInput are BYTE-UNCHANGED; the absent-map arm additionally pins `Object.keys(frame)` to the exact seven existing members, so a later widening reddens.
DELIBERATE NON-IMPORT: `boundGoalOf` lives in live-board-feed.ts, which now imports this module. Reusing it would close an import cycle, so the two-line descriptor read is inlined here instead.

(c) live-board-feed.ts 361 -> 370: after offers are parsed, `bindPlanningAuthorities(offers, planningGoalRefs, response["planningAuthorityByRun"])`; false -> the existing `unreadable()` / UNREADABLE_DETAIL (`LIVE_SURFACE_UNREADABLE`), reused not re-minted. Absent/null stays optional, matching how planningGoalRefs already treats absence.

(d) live-board.tsx 239 -> 251: `boardMayDispatch(step, planningGoalRefs, offer)` gains a third parameter defaulting to null; for the two authority-bearing kinds it demands BOTH an exact offered-run goal binding AND `hasPlanningMaterial(offer)`. The render site passes `offerFor(frame, step)` — the same kind+target+version join measured in step 1(c) — so material is read off the OFFER, never off the card.
